protocol: One revision: replace the generic LLaVA global/local evidence descriptors with the existing frozen visual Qwen extracting concise question-relevant observations; region receives marked source overview and the actual selected crop. No gold, oracle locations or accepted answers in inference. Publish aggregates only.
